title: 4 stars for the price.  Sides aren't hemmed
text: 4 stars for the price.  Sides aren't hemmed. The sides of this "tapestry" aren't hemmed, they are serged.  For the price, it's a nice backdrop or wall hanging.  It's only $10 so I think it's worth it if you are looking for this design.  The colors are great even after washing.
